code:
- uses: actions/cache@v4
  with:
    path: ~/.npm
    key: ${{ runner.os }}-npm-${{ hashFiles('package-lock.json') }}
    restore-keys: |
      ${{ runner.os }}-npm-
caption: The key tracks package-lock.json — change dependencies, get a fresh cache.
Actions → Caches lists every stored cache with its size and last-used date.

code:
- run: npm test -- --coverage
- uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
  with:
    name: coverage-report
    path: coverage/
    retention-days: 14
caption: An artifact is what this run produced, not a shortcut for the next one.
Every uploaded artifact appears right on the run's summary page as a zip.
